title: The scarf man
summary: An old man has sold scarves from a pram outside the ground for thirty years. They're not official, and the chairman wants him moved on. He asks you to have a word. A season on, the pram.

ends.title: The pram
ends.text: The old man who sells scarves from a pram outside the ground is still there. The club sells his scarves in the shop now, and he's very rude about the price.

ends.title: Moved on
ends.text: The old scarf man was moved on from outside the ground. There's an official stall there now. It sells the same scarves for twice as much.

event.title: The pram
event.speaker: chairman
setup: Outside the ground, an old man has sold scarves out of a pram for thirty years. Five pound each. Not official. {chairman.name} catches you in the car park. "He's costing the club shop money. Have a word. He'll listen to a player."

say: "Nicely, mind. I'm not a monster. Just tell him the club's brought in its own stall."

replies.label: "He's been there thirty years. I'm not moving him."
Buy a scarf off him instead, in front of everyone.

no.text: "Thirty years of not paying for a licence," says the chairman. But he doesn't send anyone else.

buy.text: You buy one and wear it on the coach. The photo goes round. The queue at the pram is longer than at the club shop for a month.

word.text: He listens. He says, "Right you are, son." He's gone the next week. The pram is in a skip by the car park.

beats.title: The pram again

event.title: The pram again
event.speaker: chairman
setup: A season on, outside the ground on match day.

outcomes.text: Still there. And in the club shop window there's a sign: "THE PRAM SCARF, AS SOLD OUTSIDE SINCE 1990." The chairman did a deal. The old man says it's daylight robbery.
An official stall, a lad in a club fleece. The same scarves, ten pound.

choices.label: Ask the chairman how the stall's doing.

outcomes.text: "His sell better than ours," he says, grimly. "So we sell his."
"Very well," he says. You notice he doesn't wear one.

beats.hint: A season on, outside the ground
